title: Ask in the Crowd: Differentially Private LLM Inference via Dummy-Augmented Shuffling
abstract: arXiv:2611.25669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as LLM-as-a-Service (LLMaaS), where user queries are sent to remote LLMs for inference, raising severe privacy concerns about the exposure of sensitive user inputs. Differentially private inference mitigates these risks by injecting noise into input embeddings. However, existing methods struggle to balance privacy and utility, as stronger privacy protection often leads to substantial accuracy degradation in LLM inference.   In this work, we propose DP-SPD, a differentially private LLM inference framework that protects user queries by hiding the real query among client-generated dummy queries. All queries are randomly shuffled before being sent to the server, preventing direct identification of the user's true intent. To improve inference efficiency, we exploit the shared-prefix structure among queries and reuse transformer key--value (KV) caches during decoding. We analyze the privacy guara

translated_title: 在人群中提问：基于虚拟查询增强混洗的差分隐私大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地以“模型即服务”（LLMaaS）的形式部署，用户查询被发送到远程大语言模型进行推理，这引发了关于敏感用户输入暴露的严重隐私担忧。差分隐私推理通过向输入嵌入中注入噪声来缓解这些风险。然而，现有方法难以在隐私和效用之间取得平衡，因为更强的隐私保护往往会导致大语言模型推理精度的大幅下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了DP-SPD——一个差分隐私的大语言模型推理框架，它通过将真实查询隐藏在客户端生成的虚拟查询之中来保护用户查询。所有查询在发送到服务器之前会被随机混洗，从而防止直接识别用户的真实意图。为了提高推理效率，我们利用查询之间的共享前缀结构，并在解码过程中复用Transformer的键值缓存。我们分析了该方法的隐私保证……
tldr: 该论文提出DP-SPD差分隐私推理框架，通过将真实查询隐藏于客户端生成的虚拟查询中并随机混洗来保护用户隐私，同时利用查询共享前缀结构与KV缓存复用提升推理效率，从而更好地平衡隐私保护与模型效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DP-SPD, a differentially private LLM inference framework that protects user queries by hiding them among client-generated dummy queries with random shuffling, while leveraging shared-prefix structure and KV cache reuse to improve efficiency and balance privacy with utility.
